scope: S_BFE_U32 in the Xbox ray-continuation translator. Synthetic values checked against one native gfx1036 device. The scalar and vector instructions encode field width differently.
isa_reference: AMD RDNA 2 ISA guide, SOP2 instruction 39
cases: For i from 0 to 4095, input = 0xc001d00d XOR ((i / 4) * 0x9e3779b9) in uint32 arithmetic, control = ((i / 32) << 16) | (i % 32). The native probe executed s_bfe_u32, then s_cselect_b32 on SCC. Each result row contains input, control, output and SCC as little-endian uint32.
translated_check: The HLSL control used the generated bit-field helper, emitted result and condition as UAV output and compared the readback against the native rows. The GPU harness repeated the same input set 16 times.
